about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Full Stack JavaScript Developer with 8+ years of experience building scalable web applications that impact thousands of users. As a team builder who enjoys challenges, I believe in the power of collaboration and knowledge sharing to create user-centric solutions that enhance efficiency. With 277 repositories and 922 followers, I'm actively contributing to the developer community.
about.paragraph2: Currently working as a Software Engineer at Clip, Mexico's leading fintech platform, I bring perseverance, capability, and innovation to every project. I specialize in scalable web applications, microservices architecture, and the modern JavaScript ecosystem. I emphasize attention to detail in UI design and believe in building applications that facilitate people's work and performance.
